title: Benjie's Treasure Map
cast: bnjyboy is a cheerful little boy about five years old playing at being a pirate. He wears a purple tricorn hat with a yellow feather, a striped shirt and brown boots. He is the ONLY person in this story and he is always alone. He sails a little wooden ship with a patched white sail on a calm blue sea beside a sandy island with palm trees.
keep: bnjyboy, a cheerful little boy about five years old in a purple tricorn hat and a striped shirt. Exactly ONE child in the picture, alone. No other people.

p1.text: A glass bottle bumped the ship. Benjie fished it out. Something was rolled up inside!
p1.art: bnjyboy alone, leaning over the rail of his little wooden ship, lifting a corked glass bottle out of the calm blue sea.

p2.text: Inside was an old paper map. It showed an island. A big red X sat on it.
p2.art: bnjyboy alone on his ship's deck, holding an old treasure map open, a big red X marked on the island drawn on it.

p3.text: The island came into view. Waves crashed on a bright reef. A quiet cove lay left.
p3.art: bnjyboy alone at the wheel of his little ship approaching a sandy island, a colourful reef with white waves on one side and a calm cove on the other.

a1.text: He sailed around the shiny reef. The water was clear as glass. Bright fish swam below.
a1.art: bnjyboy's little ship sailing over a shallow coral reef in clear turquoise water, bright tropical fish visible below.

a2.text: A grey dolphin popped up. It squeaked a hello. Benjie squeaked back!
a2.art: A friendly grey dolphin leaping beside the ship while bnjyboy leans over the rail squeaking back at it.

a3.text: He landed on a sandy beach. A rope bridge hung over a ravine. A warm shell pool sat nearby.
a3.art: bnjyboy standing alone on a wide sandy beach, a rope bridge over a leafy green ravine behind him and a shallow pool of shells to the side.

b1.text: He rowed a small boat in. The water was still and green. His oars went plip, plop.
b1.art: bnjyboy alone, rowing a small wooden rowboat into a calm green sheltered cove with tall rocks on both sides.

b2.text: A round grey seal popped up. It honked a big honk. Benjie honked back.
b2.art: A round grey seal popping its head out of the water beside the rowboat while bnjyboy honks back with his hands cupped.

b3.text: He pulled the boat onto pebbles. Crab tracks led one way. Tall grass grew the other.
b3.art: bnjyboy pulling his rowboat onto a pebble shore, small crab tracks in the sand on one side and very tall grass on the other.

aa1.text: The rope bridge swayed a little. He stepped on slowly. He held the ropes tight.
aa1.art: bnjyboy stepping carefully onto a swaying rope bridge above a leafy green ravine, holding the ropes tightly.

aa2.text: Halfway across he looked down. Green leaves waved far below. He did not look again!
aa2.art: bnjyboy in the middle of the rope bridge peeking down at the leafy green ravine far below, eyes wide.

aa3.text: Two big rocks stood there. One had a dark round hole. Pink flowers led past the other.
aa3.art: Two large mossy boulders at the end of the bridge, one with a dark round opening and a trail of pink flowers leading around the other. bnjyboy looking at both.

ab1.text: The pool was warm as a bath. Shells covered the whole bottom. He picked up a pink one.
ab1.art: bnjyboy wading alone in a warm shallow pool with a sandy bottom covered in seashells, holding up a pink shell.

ab2.text: The pink shell made a hum. He held it to his ear. It hummed a little tune.
ab2.art: bnjyboy holding a large pink seashell up to his ear with a delighted face, standing in the shallow pool.

ab3.text: The humming got louder two ways. A slow turtle walked one way. A little stream ran the other.
ab3.art: At the edge of the shell pool, a slow green sea turtle walking one way and a narrow clear stream running the other way into the palms. bnjyboy standing between them.

ba1.text: The crab tracks made tiny dots. They went up the beach. He followed them along.
ba1.art: A trail of tiny crab footprints in wet sand leading up the beach, bnjyboy following them.

ba2.text: Then he saw the crabs. A hundred little crabs! They all waved one claw.
ba2.art: A great many tiny orange crabs on the sand all raising one claw at once, bnjyboy laughing at them.

ba3.text: The tracks split at a log. Half went under the driftwood. Half went to the palms.
ba3.art: A big grey driftwood log on the sand with crab tracks going underneath it, and more tracks leading off toward palm trees. bnjyboy deciding.

bb1.text: The grass was taller than him. It tickled his nose. Benjie sneezed twice.
bb1.art: bnjyboy pushing through grass taller than he is, mid-sneeze with his purple hat tipped back.

bb2.text: Something rustled near his boots. Out came a spotted piglet. It grunted hello.
bb2.art: A small pink spotted piglet stepping out of the tall grass in front of bnjyboy, grunting cheerfully.

bb3.text: The grass opened up wide. A tall green hill rose ahead. A shady path went sideways.
bb3.art: The tall grass opening onto a view of a tall green hill ahead and a shady path under leafy trees leading off to the side. bnjyboy looking out.

aaa1.text: The hole smelled like wet stone. His voice came back twice. It was a little cave!
aaa1.art: bnjyboy peering into a dark round cave opening in a mossy boulder, calling into it.

aaa2.text: Something glittered far inside. He took a slow breath. Then he stepped in.
aaa2.art: bnjyboy stepping into a small dark cave while a faint glitter shines deeper inside.

aaa3.text: The glitter was too far away. He had a brass lantern. There was also a small gap.
aaa3.art: Inside the small cave, bnjyboy holding up an unlit brass lantern, with a narrow gap between two rocks glittering faintly beyond.

aab1.text: The flowers were bright pink. They grew in a long line. The line went uphill.
aab1.art: A long winding trail of bright pink flowers leading up a green hillside, bnjyboy walking along it.

aab2.text: The air smelled sweet and warm. Bees hummed over the flowers. Butterflies danced above them.
aab2.art: bnjyboy walking through pink flowers with fat bumblebees humming low and blue butterflies fluttering above.

aab3.text: The bees flew off one way. The butterflies went the other. Both looked worth following.
aab3.art: At the top of the flower hill, bumblebees flying off toward a hollow tree and blue butterflies drifting the other way. bnjyboy watching.

aba1.text: The turtle was very slow. He walked slowly too. Nobody was in a hurry.
aba1.art: A large green sea turtle walking slowly across the sand with bnjyboy strolling patiently behind it.

aba2.text: The turtle stopped by a rock. It blinked at him kindly. Then it began to dig.
aba2.art: The green turtle stopping beside a flat grey rock and starting to dig in the sand with one flipper, bnjyboy watching closely.

aba3.text: Sand flew everywhere. The turtle looked at the sea. Then it looked at its hole.
aba3.art: The turtle beside a small dug hole in the sand, looking back toward the blue sea while bnjyboy kneels by the hole.

abb1.text: The stream was cold and clear. It ran over smooth stones. His boots went splish, splash.
abb1.art: bnjyboy walking up a shallow clear stream running over smooth round stones between palm trees.

abb2.text: Small silver fish swam past. They all went upstream. A big rock sat ahead.
abb2.art: A group of small silver fish swimming upstream past bnjyboy's boots toward a large round mossy rock ahead.

abb3.text: The fish slipped under the rock. The rock looked easy to move. Or he could keep following.
abb3.art: A large round mossy rock sitting in the streambed with silver fish darting underneath it, bnjyboy standing beside it.

baa1.text: The log was old and grey. He tipped it up slowly. Underneath was cool damp sand.
baa1.art: bnjyboy tipping up a big grey driftwood log, revealing cool damp sand underneath.

baa2.text: Something small and shiny sat there. It was a tiny brass key. He picked it up.
baa2.art: A tiny brass key lying in the damp sand under the lifted log, bnjyboy picking it up carefully.

baa3.text: A key needs a lock. The sand looked soft below. But maybe a lock was near.
baa3.art: bnjyboy holding a tiny brass key up to the light, the soft sand where the log had been beside him.

bab1.text: The palm trees were very tall. Their leaves clapped in the wind. Coconuts hung up high.
bab1.art: A group of very tall palm trees with green leaves moving in the wind and clusters of coconuts high up, bnjyboy looking up.

bab2.text: One coconut wobbled up there. The wind pushed it around. It did not fall down.
bab2.art: A cluster of coconuts high in a windy palm tree, bnjyboy watching them from below.

bab3.text: One palm stood taller than all. Something was tied near its top. A coconut could be shaken down.
bab3.art: One palm tree taller than the rest with a small cloth bundle tied near its top, and lower coconuts on a shorter palm nearby.

bba1.text: The hill was steep and green. He climbed it slowly. The piglet came too.
bba1.art: bnjyboy climbing a steep green grassy hill with the small spotted piglet trotting along behind him.

bba2.text: At the top he saw everything. The sea went on and on. His ship looked tiny.
bba2.art: bnjyboy standing on a green hilltop looking out over the wide blue sea with his little ship far below.

bba3.text: He had a brass spyglass. Then something bright flew past. It was a red kite!
bba3.art: bnjyboy raising a brass spyglass on the hilltop while a bright red paper kite sails past on the wind.

bbb1.text: The shady path was cool. Big leaves hung overhead. Everything was quiet and green.
bbb1.art: bnjyboy walking along a cool shady path under very large green leaves, soft light coming through.

bbb2.text: Round toadstools grew in a ring. They were red with white spots. He did not step inside.
bbb2.art: A neat ring of red toadstools with white spots growing on the shady path floor, bnjyboy crouching to look at them.

bbb3.text: It grew darker under the leaves. Little lights blinked on. Fireflies! Or he could peek inside.
bbb3.art: Dusk on the shady path with many small glowing fireflies blinking in the air above a ring of red spotted toadstools. bnjyboy watching.

aaaa1.text: The lantern lit the whole cave. Gold light danced on the walls. And there sat a chest!
aaaa1.art: A lit brass lantern filling a small cave with warm gold light, showing an old wooden chest sitting against the back wall. bnjyboy amazed.

aaaa2.text: The lid came up with a creak. Warm sweet air puffed out. It was full of cookies!
aaaa2.art: The wooden chest open in the lantern light, completely full of round golden cookies, bnjyboy astonished.

aaaa3.text: He ate cookies in the cave. Crumbs went everywhere. It was a very good day.
aaaa3.art: bnjyboy sitting alone on the cave floor eating cookies by warm lantern light, crumbs on his chin.

aaab1.text: He reached through the gap. His hand found something soft. He pulled it out slowly.
aaab1.art: bnjyboy reaching his arm through a narrow gap between two cave rocks, feeling for something.

aaab2.text: It was a bundle of blankets. They were thick and warm. Something was rolled inside.
aaab2.art: bnjyboy pulling a bundle of thick striped blankets out of a gap in the cave rocks, something wrapped in the middle.

aaab3.text: Inside was a sleepy kitten. It yawned a tiny yawn. It liked him straight away.
aaab3.art: A small sleepy grey kitten curled in the middle of unrolled blankets, yawning, while bnjyboy smiles down at it in the cave.

aaba1.text: The bees flew to a hollow tree. They hummed a happy hum. The bark was sticky.
aaba1.art: Bumblebees flying into a hole in a hollow tree trunk with golden sticky honey running down the bark, bnjyboy watching.

aaba2.text: Honey dripped from the hole. He caught some on his finger. It tasted like warm flowers.
aaba2.art: Golden honey dripping from a hole in a tree trunk onto bnjyboy's finger as he tastes it with a delighted face.

aaba3.text: The bees let him fill a jar. He said thank you politely. Honey on ship bread is best.
aaba3.art: bnjyboy carefully filling a glass jar with golden honey while friendly bumblebees hum around him.

aabb1.text: The butterflies flew in a line. Blue wings flashed in the sun. They led over a hill.
aabb1.art: A line of blue butterflies flying over a small grassy hill in bright sunshine, bnjyboy following below.

aabb2.text: Behind the hill was a garden. Someone planted it long ago. Now it grew by itself.
aabb2.art: A wild overgrown garden of vegetables and flowers hidden behind a hill, blue butterflies drifting over it.

aabb3.text: He picked ripe red tomatoes. And beans and fat carrots. Dinner would be very good.
aabb3.art: bnjyboy picking ripe red tomatoes, green beans and carrots in the wild garden, his arms full of vegetables.

abaa1.text: He walked with the turtle. It went straight to the sea. It stopped by the waves.
abaa1.art: The green turtle walking down the wet sand to the edge of the sea, bnjyboy walking beside it.

abaa2.text: The sand there was wiggling. Tiny flippers pushed up. Baby turtles, lots of them!
abaa2.art: Many tiny baby turtles pushing up out of the wet sand near the water's edge, bnjyboy kneeling in delight.

abaa3.text: He helped them to the water. Every single one made it. That beat gold any day.
abaa3.art: bnjyboy gently guiding tiny baby turtles across the sand into the shallow waves, the big turtle watching.

abab1.text: He dug where the turtle stopped. The sand came out easily. His hands hit something hard.
abab1.art: bnjyboy digging with his hands in the sand beside the flat grey rock, a hard shape appearing in the hole.

abab2.text: It was a small tin box. The lid was painted blue. Something rattled inside it.
abab2.art: A small tin box with faded blue paint lifted out of a sandy hole, held in bnjyboy's hands.

abab3.text: Inside were seeds in packets. Someone loved this island. Now he could plant more.
abab3.art: The open tin box full of small paper seed packets, bnjyboy looking at them thoughtfully on the beach.

abba1.text: He followed the silver fish. The stream got wider and wider. Then it opened up.
abba1.art: The shallow stream widening into a clear round pool ringed by ferns, silver fish swimming ahead of bnjyboy.

abba2.text: A little waterfall splashed down. The pool was deep and cool. The fish swam in circles.
abba2.art: A small waterfall splashing into a clear deep pool with silver fish circling, ferns all around, bnjyboy arriving.

abba3.text: He swam all afternoon. He floated on his back. Nobody thought about treasure.
abba3.art: bnjyboy swimming happily in the clear pool below the little waterfall, his purple hat resting on a rock.

abbb1.text: The rock rolled away slowly. Water rushed into the hole. Something round sat below.
abbb1.art: bnjyboy rolling the large mossy rock aside in the streambed, water rushing into the hollow, a round shape below.

abbb2.text: It was a stone jar with a lid. The lid was stuck fast. He twisted it hard.
abbb2.art: bnjyboy twisting the stuck lid of a round stone jar lifted from the streambed.

abbb3.text: Pop! Out came a music box. It played a slow little song. He listened all the way.
abbb3.art: A small open music box sitting on a flat rock by the stream playing a tune, bnjyboy listening quietly.

baaa1.text: He dug down into the sand. Deeper and deeper he went. The hole got quite big.
baaa1.art: bnjyboy digging a deep hole in the sand where the driftwood log had been, sand piled up beside him.

baaa2.text: Then came a wooden thump. It was a little chest! It had a small brass lock.
baaa2.art: A small wooden chest with a brass lock sitting at the bottom of the sandy hole, bnjyboy reaching for it.

baaa3.text: The key fit the lock. Inside were round glass marbles. Every colour he could name.
baaa3.art: The little chest open on the sand, full of shiny glass marbles in many colours, the tiny brass key lying beside it.

baab1.text: He looked for the lock everywhere. Under rocks and in shells. Then he found it.
baab1.art: bnjyboy searching along the pebble shore, pointing at something hidden in the rocks.

baab2.text: A tiny door sat in a rock. It was no taller than his boot. The little key went in.
baab2.art: A tiny wooden door set into a large rock on the shore, no taller than a boot, with a small brass keyhole.

baab3.text: Inside was a little tea set. Four small cups and a pot. Someone tiny lived well.
baab3.art: Behind the tiny open door, a miniature china tea set with four little cups and a teapot on a shelf of rock.

baba1.text: He shook the shorter palm. Thump! Down came a coconut. It rolled to his boots.
baba1.art: A coconut falling from a shaken palm tree and rolling to a stop at bnjyboy's brown boots.

baba2.text: He cracked it on a rock. Sweet white milk spilled out. He drank it right there.
baba2.art: bnjyboy cracking a coconut open on a rock with coconut milk spilling out, catching it in a tin cup.

baba3.text: More coconuts came down. He carried them all back. Coconut milk for the trip home.
baba3.art: bnjyboy walking back along the beach with his arms full of coconuts, one balanced on his purple hat.

babb1.text: He climbed the tallest palm. It was slow work. His hat nearly fell off.
babb1.art: bnjyboy climbing high up the trunk of the tallest palm tree, holding his purple hat on with one hand.

babb2.text: The bundle was tied with rope. He untied it carefully. Down it came on a string.
babb2.art: bnjyboy near the top of the palm untying a small cloth bundle and lowering it down on a string.

babb3.text: Inside was a soft teddy bear. Someone had missed it. He gave it a hug.
babb3.art: A soft worn teddy bear sitting in an opened cloth bundle on the sand, bnjyboy hugging it gently.

bbaa1.text: He looked through the spyglass. He turned it slowly around. Then he said, "Oh my!"
bbaa1.art: bnjyboy on the green hilltop looking through a brass spyglass with a very surprised face.

bbaa2.text: Below sat a little cottage. Smoke curled from its chimney. A cat sat on the step.
bbaa2.art: A small cottage in a green valley below the hill with smoke rising from the chimney and an orange cat sitting on the doorstep.

bbaa3.text: He went down for a look. Warm scones sat on a table. The cat shared them nicely.
bbaa3.art: bnjyboy sitting at a small table outside the valley cottage with scones and a mug, an orange cat beside him.

bbab1.text: He chased the red kite. It dipped and swooped. He caught its long tail.
bbab1.art: bnjyboy running across the green hilltop catching the tail of a bright red paper kite.

bbab2.text: The string was long and loose. Nobody was holding it. The wind had set it free.
bbab2.art: bnjyboy holding a red kite and its long loose string on the breezy green hilltop, looking around.

bbab3.text: He flew it all afternoon. It danced above the sea. Pirates make good kite flyers.
bbab3.art: bnjyboy flying the bright red kite high above the green hilltop with the blue sea behind him.

bbba1.text: He peeked into the ring. The grass inside was soft. Someone made a little bed.
bbba1.art: Looking down into a ring of red spotted toadstools where the soft grass has been flattened into a small round nest.

bbba2.text: Two round eyes blinked up. It was a tiny brown mouse. It was not scared.
bbba2.art: A tiny brown mouse sitting in the small grass nest inside the toadstool ring, looking up calmly.

bbba3.text: The mouse showed him its store. Nuts and berries, neatly stacked. It shared one berry.
bbba3.art: The tiny brown mouse beside a neat little pile of nuts and red berries, handing a berry to bnjyboy's fingertip.

bbbb1.text: He followed the little lights. The fireflies drifted slowly. The path glowed around him.
bbbb1.art: bnjyboy walking along the dark shady path surrounded by many glowing fireflies lighting his way.

bbbb2.text: The fireflies filled a clearing. There were thousands of them. It looked like a sky.
bbbb2.art: A dark forest clearing completely filled with thousands of glowing fireflies like a field of stars, bnjyboy standing amazed.

bbbb3.text: He sat down and watched. He did not say a word. It was the best treasure.
bbbb3.art: bnjyboy sitting quietly on the ground watching thousands of fireflies glow all around him.
